query: SELECT mp.id, mp.userId, u.name, u.email, mp.university, mp.major, mp.region, mp.isActive FROM mentor_profiles mp JOIN users u ON mp.userId = u.id WHERE mp.isActive = true AND mp.isDeleted = false;
